decisions.reason: With W=0 the first validation operation returns before classification, so the previously required predicates and inversion count had no value. Initialized counts and lists before charged work and marked all uncomputed diagnostics unavailable; requested r remains separate. Exact swap systems, Gram–Schmidt graph completion and residual transport remain unchanged. The three direct item consumers only use completed ordering or status returns and remain sound.

The Bartels–Stewart supplier requires pivot threshold, both Schur controls, c0, sweep limits and controller budget; none was an input of the original call. Added a complete per-pass packet, specified coefficient order Aj*,Aj and right-hand side −S(Kj), and declared integer N,L. For dyadic inexact inputs, exact rational gain formation is retained and a common positive denominator scales the current-cost system to dyadic point-certifier inputs without changing its solution. Trial Neumann and raw residual bounds remain separate from preconditioned residual data.

For scalar R=3,B=1 the exact coefficient BR−1B*=1/3 is not dyadic, so the original finite recurrence had no initial stored G0. Finite initialization now solves RV=B* by the stated complete-pivoting rule in exact rational preprocessing, rounds BV and C*C componentwise to the declared format, and records rounding differences and failure diagnostics. The exact-mode standard coefficients and all three recurrence formulas remain unchanged. This adds no point-certificate calls, preserves the finite-status call bounds, and asserts no bit complexity or rounded PSD invariant.

Proof 1.2 computed only ΦG(H+A*UA)−ΦG(H); its outside factors were (I+HG)−1A* and A(I+GH)−1, which are not A1*,A1. Restored the outer A* and A from f(f(X))−H1, yielding A*(I+HG)−1A*=A1* and A(I+GH)−1A=A1. The middle inverse is (X−1+G1)−1, so the composition follows for positive X. Kernel positivity proves all required inverses and PSD updates; continuity extends to singular PSD X and induction yields Hj=f^(2^j)(0). Statement and exact-mode interface are unchanged.

F5 attributed a raw residual bound and an inverse-norm bound κ to a definition that supplies only approximate-inverse defect q and preconditioned residual bounds. Corrected that restatement and attributed κ and raw r in Proof 2.1 to the explicit Statement hypotheses. This is nonfatal because those exact hypotheses already suffice: the Lyapunov witness forces Hurwitz stability, positivity of Q+Kt*RKt gives the PSD exact cost, and inverse-times-raw-residual plus η proves Pt≤Xj. The Statement is unchanged and the repaired supplier preserves every acceptance test.

F2 generalized a definition of linear defect q and preconditioned residual r to unrelated DARE enclosure constants. Corrected its scope and routed Proof 2.1–3.1 to the already explicit A1 hypotheses. Nonfatal: A1 and the Statement already assume the positive S-margin, norm/residual/inverse bounds and Stein margin. Checked the resolvent bounds for K and Ac, derivative Ac*EAc−E and its Lipschitz constant, Taylor remainder and closed-ball contraction, then the strict Stein perturbation bound and telescoping identity proving PSD. Statement and all radius/stability conditions remain unchanged.
